{CBastian{x is the goat-legged god of orgies, pleasure, and debauchery, patron of {hh159satyrs{x, wallower in the dirt and stirrer of trouble. Legend has it that Bastian was once a mortal man, hopelessly in love with the satyr goddess {hh1580Cradya{x. The gods heard his prayers and turned him into a satyr. Upon reaching the heavens, Bastian became one of the patrons of {hh2097Chaos{x, bringing a touch of merry madness even into the celestial empyrean. Don't confuse him with {hh969Bast{x -- that is an entirely different goddess.

Every cup of liquor, beer or wine starts or prolongs Bastian's revel: sharper aim and heavier blows, extra health, mana and spell power, spell defense, regeneration, and a stomach that shrugs off poison and disease. {x A fight opens with a {hh865hangover acid blow{x, and later in battle the mark will belch a foul {hh696gas cloud{x at a crowd or more acid at a single foe. {x Oh yes, and it will also reward you with vulnerability to drowning. {x When you're drunk, you know, the sea isn't always ankle-deep %A% =Restrictions:= only the {hh30non-lawful{x (naturally!)
